title: Victoria Zipline Adventure Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Participants must weigh a minimum of 60lbs (28kg) and a maximum of 275lbs (125kg)
Absolutely no alcohol, cannabis, or illicit drug use permitted prior to or during a tour.
All guests are required to sign a waiver. Participants under 19 must have a parent or guardian’s signature. The waiver must be completed at the time of check-in and witnessed by staff.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund
Must arrive 20 minutes before the scheduled tour time: check-in 20 minutes before the tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience an exhilarating outdoor adventure that takes place on 100 acres of coastal temperate rainforest with magnificent mountain and ocean views. All tours are fully guided by our professionally trained staff who make the experience carefree and comfortable while offering educational insight into the wildlife, history, and natural beauty of the West Coast. 8 ziplines, a 100 ft suspension bridges, and a 10 minute safari style ride up to the top of the zipline course are included in your adventure.
